Q: Warning: mysqli::prepare() [mysqli.prepare]: invalid object or resource A:

Using new mysqli() without any parameters is identical to mysqli_init(). It produces a mysqli object without attempting the connection. Any attempt to call any method on that object will result in an error. You need to connect.

The easiest way to connect is to pass the necessary arguments to the new mysqli constructor, but you can also call real_connect() or connect() method to connect after creating the object.

Q: How to use MAP() , BYCOL() or BYROW() to return multiple arrays? A:

Sort Column by Column(s)

Best

=LET(r,A2:A5,v,B2:E5,
    DROP(REDUCE("",SEQUENCE(COLUMNS(v)),LAMBDA(a,i,
        HSTACK(a,SORTBY(r,INDEX(v,,i))))),,1))

SORTBY(r,INDEX(v,,i)) is the same as DROP(SORT(HSTACK(INDEX(v,,i),r)),,1)!!!

Initial Answer

=LET(r,A2:A5,v,B2:E5,
    DROP(REDUCE("",SEQUENCE(COLUMNS(v)),LAMBDA(a,i,
        HSTACK(a,DROP(SORT(HSTACK(INDEX(v,,i),r)),,1)))),,1))

G2:Q5 represents SORT(HSTACK(INDEX(v,,i),r)) on each iteration.

Q: How do I make my arcade game character have three jumps, standing still, jump when walking and jump when running? A:

Assuming you're working with the player.gd script that's baked into Godot and not writing your own from scratch, a lot of the foundational stuff should already be there. First add two variables:

jump_count = 0
max_jumps = 2

Something like that should work. Next, tweak the preexisting jump function to factor in the double jump:

if Input.is_action_just_pressed("ui_accept") and jump_count < max_jumps:
    velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
    jump_count += 1

From here everything should be fine, just make sure to add an if statement that checks if the player is on the floor and sets the jump_count back to 0 and add that BEFORE the actual jump function. Neglect this and the player won't be able to jump again after touching the floor after the first jump.

Q: GitGuardian in GitHub: how to set secrets to be ignored? A:

Your config is fine — it just doesn’t apply to GitHub PR checks.

Key point:
.gitguardian.yaml only works for local ggshield, not for GitHub.

✅ Fix (what actually works)

Go to GitGuardian dashboard → Settings → Secrets Detection → Exclusion Rules

Then either:

Option 1 (best for tests)

**/tests/**
**/*test*

Option 2 (specific secret)
Use the exact string as a regex.

TL;DR

Repo config ❌
Dashboard exclusion ✅
